frames.gloss: 伪裂句（wh-分裂句）：把想强调的内容装进 what 主语从句，再用系动词接出解释或评价，整句＝「……的是……」。
frames.pattern_notes:
前半 What 引导的是主语从句而非疑问句（What surprised Xie Lei was...＝Xie Lei 感到惊讶的是...），后半 be 后接 that-从句或名词补语。
误读点：学习者易把 What...was 当成疑问句+意外系动词，应整存整取为「先抛悬念再给解释」的句式。
变体：What is worse is that... 是话语连接语用法（＝worse still / to make matters worse），正文用法则如 What surprised X was that...。

examples.s: What surprised Xie Lei was that she found herself speaking up in class after just a few weeks.
What is worse is that do not need to be blind at all.

frames.gloss: 一……就……／就在……那一瞬：用「the＋时间名词＋零关系词从句」代替 when/as soon as 引导时间从句。
frames.pattern_notes:
时间名词 minute/second(s) 等直接带零关系词从句，从句可前置（The minute I sat down, ...）也可后置（... in the 30 seconds the earth moved）。
误读点：学习者会把 The minute I sat down 读成「这一分钟我坐下」的名词短语，意识不到 minute 在此起连词作用。
对应显性连词是 as soon as（本批 S03659 另有一例），the minute 是其名词性变体。

examples.s: The minute I sat down in front of the TV, my mom came over.
All of the ways man had made to keep the city safe were gone in the 30 seconds the earth moved.

frames.gloss: ……的方式：way 作先行词接关系从句，in which／that／零关系词三种形式。
frames.pattern_notes:
与已有框架 the reason(s) why 完全平行，way 后的关系词可整体省略：in the way they express anger（他们表达愤怒的方式）。
误读点：in the way＋从句易被错切成「挡道的 in the way」状语＋新主句；且学习者常误产出 the way how。
正式语体保留 in which（The way in which he did the experiment），口语和教材最常见的是零关系词。

examples.s: How are humans and chimps alike in the way they express anger?
The way in which he did the experiment was puzzling to other people.

frames.gloss: 做……有困难／吃力（＝have difficulty doing）。
frames.pattern_notes:
trouble 后必须接动名词，不能接 to do；介词 in 通常省略，主语是人。
误读点：学习者产出 have trouble to see 等错误形式，需把「have trouble＋V-ing」整存整取。
属动词补语构式，与已有清单中的 end up（V-ing）同一收录层级；另有 have trouble with sth 变体。

examples.s: Indeed, they thought the statue was too good to go on top of the cathedral where people would have trouble seeing it.
MAKING YOUR HOME SAFE FOR THE ELDERLY The elderly present special challenges, as they may have trouble moving about and can be seriously hurt in falls.

frames.gloss: （某物／某事）的目的／宗旨是……：名词化主语＋系动词＋不定式表语的定义性句式。
frames.pattern_notes:
主语是名词化 NP（the aim/purpose of X），表语位置固定用 to 不定式，不用 for V-ing；aim 可换 goal/objective。
误读点：学习者在 be 后期待名词，或把 to V 误读成目的状语，实为表语；学术／说明语篇开头的高频句式。
两句分别用 aim 与 purpose、is 与 was，证明框架对时态和名词选择有开放槽位。

examples.s: The aim of the programme is to between the two nations.
The Middle Ages (from the 5th to the 15th century) During the Middle Ages, the purpose of Western art was to teach people about Christianity.

candidates.note: 「the＋最高级＋(that)＋S＋ever＋V-ed」（最……过的）：骨架与误读判据均满足，但本批仅 1 例，需跨批找到第 2 例验证后收录。

example.s: Looking at the beautiful scenery, they both agreed that it was the most awesome journey they had ever taken.

candidates.note: 「be to blame」：该受责备／是……的问题；误读判据极强（学习者误说 is to be blamed），但本批仅 1 例，且偏短语级。

example.s: Snow suspected that the water pump was to blame.

candidates.note: 「Contrary to what＋从句,＋主句」：与普遍看法相反……；前置评注状语，仅 1 例。

example.s: Daiyu: Well, contrary contrary to what many people believe, there are a lot of vast and empty spaces in China, actually.

candidates.note: 「Speaking of＋N,＋主句」：与已有 when it comes to 同功能的话语标记变体，仅 1 例。

example.s: Speaking of medicine, through new technology, people who have brain or spinal injuries will be able to find new hope.

candidates.note: 「Especially＋adj＋be＋NP」（补语前置倒装）：误读判据强（表语提前、主语后置），仅 1 例。

example.s: Especially amazing is the Incas’ dry stone method of building.

candidates.note: 「序数/最高级＋N＋to＋V」：the first person in the world to enter space；不定式后置修饰名词，仅 1 例。

example.s: Afterwards, the USSR focused on sending people into space, and on 12 April 1961, Yuri Gagarin became the first person in the world to enter space.

candidates.note: 「ever since」收句尾（has been in use ... ever since＝从那以后一直）：仅 1 例，短语级。

example.s: The samovar was then proudly placed in her main room and has been in use by my family ever since.

candidates.note: 「For those who＋V,＋评论」：对那些……的人来说；量限性评注框架，仅 1 例。

example.s: For those who live in cities like we do, spending time in nature can be an incredibly rejuvenating experience.

candidates.note: 「Have you ever＋V-ed?」经验问句：本批 3 例（另 S04396、J05224），重复充分，但本质是现在完成时问句，判据 1（时体范畴不报）边界拿不准。

example.s: A: Have you ever been to the space museum?

candidates.note: 「概括NP：冒号展开」：预告性名词＋冒号同位展开（另见 S02595 full name...: the United Kingdom...、S01311 two things...: to eat...）；骨架只靠标点无固定虚词，判据 1 拿不准。

example.s: All these shows have one thing in common: They try to look for the best singers, the most talented dancers, the most exciting magicians, the funniest actors and so on.

candidates.note: 「Whoever＋V,＋主句」：自由关系代词＝the person who（谁要是……），与已有 no matter wh- 的让步义不同，仅 1 例。

example.s: Whoever took this could live forever, and Hou Yi planned to take it with Chang'e.

candidates.note: 「few would not＋V」：litotes 双重否定（几乎人人都会）；修辞构式，仅 1 例。

example.s: From Bill Gates to Steve Jobs to Jack Ma, few would not recognise their names.

candidates.note: 「This is because＋从句」：指示回指整句＋原因，已有清单含 This is why/what，此为 because 变体；仅 1 例。

example.s: This is because any big computer problem could cause one or more planes full of people to crash!

candidates.note: 「N is easy/difficult for X to V」tough 构式：loans are becoming easier ... to obtain 中主语是不定式的逻辑宾语；误读强但本批仅 1 例，判据 1 构式语法边界拿不准。

example.s: Business development loans are becoming easier for these young people to obtain, too.

candidates.note: 「thanks to＋NP」：多亏了／由于（褒义原因）；仅 1 例，短语级。

example.s: Today, more than people have had their eyesight restored, thanks to the work of the foundation.
